evidence.quote: Even if you select two Availability Zones when configuring your domain, OpenSearch Service automatically distributes [dedicated master nodes](managedomains-dedicatedmasternodes.md) across three Availability Zones.
If you choose an older-generation instance type that is not available in three Availability Zones, the following scenarios apply:
If you chose two Availability Zones for the domain, OpenSearch Service distributes the dedicated master nodes across two zones.

claim: Even if you select two Availability Zones when configuring your Amazon OpenSearch Service domain, OpenSearch Service automatically distributes dedicated master nodes across three Availability Zones; if you choose an older-generation instance type that is not available in three Availability Zones and chose two zones, it distributes the dedicated master nodes across two zones.

qualifiers.scope: dedicated master nodes of a multi-AZ domain

note: d013 | adjudicate-35 moved from condition (not carried by the quote): If an older-generation instance type is not available in three Availability Zones, and you chose two zones, the master nodes are distributed across two zones.
